description: Create a new conference as a DRAFT — it is not publicly visible until someone publishes it in Congressio, so this is safe to use while still deciding details. Use it when the user wants to start organising a new conference. Needs a name and an IANA timezone (for example Europe/Paris); dates are optional and can be added later in the UI. Confirm the name, timezone and dates with the user before calling, since the draft appears in their organization immediately. Returns the new conference's id and slug. This tool requires an OAuth connection rather than an API key, because a created conference records who created it — with an API key it returns a 403 explaining that. It can also fail with 402 if the organization's plan has no room for another active conference, which is not something retrying will fix. Requires the organization API key to be configured; without one this returns an error telling the user where to create a key.

endDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must not be before startDate.

name.description: The conference name, as attendees will see it.

startDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must not be in the past.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Paris. Dates are interpreted in it, so ask the user rather than guessing.

name: create_draft_conference
title: Create a draft conference
